limits: Exact native trollCaveA / enTroll01 / renderer 121153 source assignment only; sibling troll rows, renderer sources, and the separate Gloamcap resource-prefab route do not receive credit.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 58 HP to 48 HP; death used the separate explicit KillSingle fixture at 48 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Twenty-eight selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 332 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture death completed all 120 requested frames through deathHeavy_troll with m_DoRagdoll true; 11 surviving native rigidbodies become nonkinematic from retained frame 28. The physical corpse is visible through retained frame 119, and no later lifetime is claimed.

The exact renderer stayed active, enabled, visible, and identity-stable in all 360 retained frames; native combat UI, bright effects, foreground hero overlap, loot overlay, depth blur, and camera motion limit fine inspection.
One guarded native Collect action reached strict Ready at level 0 room 2; broader campaign progression was not exercised.
The native Standard material retains emission keyword state, white emission color, and trollCave_e, so the pale authored base color appears warmer in game than its source texture.

Intentional gaps between authored rock masses remain a scoped prototype-art limitation; no sampled tearing, renderer loss, viewport-edge clipping, floor fall-through, or unintended animated-section detachment was observed.

Other troll controller clips and proficiencies, sibling sources, portraits, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.

selectedPNGs.observation: The exact Mirewarden renderer is fully visible in settled cidle_troll at native scale. Its head, torso, arms, hands, legs, and separate rock masses form the intended large troll silhouette without viewport or floor clipping.
A later idle sample preserves the same centered rock-troll proportions and readable face. The warm dungeon light changes the apparent surface color without hiding geometry.
The ordinary no-focus action begins from an intact visible Mirewarden at 58 HP. The input UI covers the hero and leaves the enemy silhouette readable.
Before impact the custom troll remains settled and fully assembled while the native roll resolves. This frame does not establish damage deformation by itself.
The separate explicit KillSingle fixture starts from an intact visible Mirewarden at 48 HP. This baseline is fixture evidence and does not establish ordinary lethal behavior.

The physical corpse is still visible behind the loot overlay at the final requested capture frame. This proves only the sampled window; the fixture does not establish ordinary lethal behavior or a later corpse lifetime.
The opening idle frame shows the exact custom troll centered on its tile with a coherent full-body silhouette and the authored surface readable under native lighting.
At the native AttackProf trigger boundary the troll begins a forward weight shift while all sampled rock sections remain aligned with the articulated body.
The opening attackProf_troll lunge carries the authored torso and limbs toward the hero as one readable figure.

At proficiency contact the troll overlaps the hero as intended while the head, shoulders, arms, and legs retain a coherent attack silhouette. The hero and impact effect limit inspection of the lower torso and near hand.
The final attackProf_troll recovery returns the custom troll toward its target tile with the large segmented silhouette intact and no sampled tearing or detached animated section.
The controller has returned to cidle_troll with the original centered stance restored immediately after the native proficiency action.
The attack capture opens with the exact Mirewarden settled in cidle_troll at 58 HP and all major rock masses aligned.
At the native Damaged trigger boundary the hero and bright impact sphere substantially obscure the troll. This frame establishes action timing but provides limited deformation evidence.
The damage_troll response begins with the Mirewarden recoiling as a connected figure. Exposed head, shoulders, arms, and legs retain their intended proportions around the foreground hero.
The ordinary hit reaction reaches a readable recoil pose with the rock torso and articulated limbs still assembled. Foreground overlap prevents a complete view of the lower body.
The damage_troll recovery finishes with the troll upright and coherent after the ordinary HP transition from 58 to 48.
The controller returns to cidle_troll with the pre-hit stance and full custom silhouette restored.
The native attack_troll action opens with the Mirewarden leaning and lifting toward the hero. Its head, massive arms, torso, and legs remain aligned.
At direct contact the troll bends over the hero in a coherent strike pose and the native 9-damage result is visible. Hero overlap hides part of the near hand and lower torso.
The final attack_troll frame has carried the authored model back to its tile with the complete large silhouette readable and intact.
The next frame is settled cidle_troll, confirming visible recovery from the native counterattack without residual stretch or displacement.
The explicit fixture impact is dominated by the hero and bright sphere. The exposed upper troll remains recognizable, while this frame is used for trigger timing rather than fine shape assessment.
At lethal resolution the 1000-damage label and native particles overlap the troll, but its upright head, torso, arms, and legs remain visibly coherent as deathHeavy_troll begins.
The next death frame preserves the standing custom silhouette while the captured body telemetry first reports all 11 surviving rigidbodies as nonkinematic.
The Mirewarden has completed its visible physical fall and lies on the floor as a readable rock-troll corpse. The hero partially covers the near arm.
The defeated custom troll remains visibly collapsed after combat UI clears. Its large torso and limb masses remain recognizable while the encounter transitions toward loot.
The native gold-loot panel is open while the collapsed custom troll remains visible in the blurred background. The overlay limits detailed geometry inspection.
